parsed.lessons_learned: Portfolio dropped from $30K to $25K despite LP strategy. The impermanent loss from holding ETH in LP when pool price > oracle is real. Need to be more careful about IL direction. The key issue: when pool price is above oracle, arb bots will sell ETH into the pool, converting my LP position gradually from USDT to ETH. At $2,800 oracle, I'm receiving ETH at a 'discount' to what I could have held. The fee income needs to offset this IL. At 138K pool depth, this math is tighter. Keep wider ranges and maintain USDT reserves for the asymmetric opportunity.
